data.title: 2B · 凯妮蕾丝战装跨坐骑乘与上下轻摇
data.description: 成年2B独自跨坐折叠软垫，蓝白战斗内衣松开，一手撑住床褥、一手在腿间自抚，武器与Pod均关闭置于远处。
data.location: 抵抗军营地帐篷行军榻
data.action: 独自跨坐软垫，一手撑床、一手腿间自抚
data.lighting: 营火透过帐篷帆布透射的暖橙光晕照亮玉体
data.promptProse: Viewed from a low angle inside a quiet canvas tent lit by warm orange campfire glow, 2B sits astride a folded futon with one hand steadying herself on the cloth while her sword and powered-down Pod rest out of reach behind her.
data.nsfwProse: Her ice-blue floral lace combat leotard is pulled open off her bare chest and shifted aside at the crotch above sheer black thigh-high stockings as her free hand touches herself.
data.animaCaption: Straddling a folded futon inside the firelit camp tent with her sword and powered-down Pod resting behind her, she braces one hand on the bedding while sliding the other past her loosened ice-blue lace leotard between her stockinged thighs.
